Have you ever been a Nielson Box family? What was it like?

My sister is. It's nothing special. You have a box between your cable box and TV (might be in front of the cable box, I don't remember). When the Nielson Box is on, is sends data back as to the time and channel. You can turn it off so they won't know what you are watching (and they say that you should if you ever have company over). And for that you get a few extra bucks a month.

Really, I find the whole concept outdated. The cable companies already know what shows you are watching. So, why doesn't Nielson get the data from them?

Nope, got a flier from them in the mail once though. By then I had given up cable altogether and gone straight to Netflix and Streaming sites, so I chucked it in the bin.

Kinda starting to wonder if I should have just responded and explained my situation to them.
